title: Handoff Quickcard with Inline Postmortem Shortcuts and Cost Snapshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable 'Handoff Quickcard' surface that appears in incident and alert detail pages. The card aggregates: 1) key SLO delta metrics since alert triggered, 2) a light cost snapshot (estimated cost delta last 1h / 24h) with token counts, and 3) direct shortcuts to create or jump to postmortem artifacts (Confluence/Drive), linked PRs, and the on-call owner's contact. The goal is to reduce context switching for engineers during handoffs and accelerate postmortem creation while surfacing cost implications that help prioritize mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Quickcard is visible on incident detail and alert timeline when SLOs are attached
SLO deltas (error budget burned %, latency p50/p95 delta) render with color-coded deltas and tooltip explanations
Cost snapshot computes and displays token-based estimate and links to the cost breakdown dashboard
Primary action buttons: 'Open Postmortem Draft', 'Notify On-Call', 'Attach PR' are available and wired to correct flows
Design responsive behavior: collapses into a single-line summary at <= 600px, expands as a two-column card at >= 960px
Design handoff microcopy includes timestamp and last-updated actor and respects RBAC visibility rules
design_notes: Prioritize scannability: metric glyph + numeric delta + microcopy explaining calculation window
Use existing color tokens from Console theme (danger/warning/success) to indicate SLO health; avoid new colors
Cost snapshot should be conservative and clearly labeled as 'estimated' with a link to the cost model used
Primary CTA should be horizontally prominent; secondary actions collapsed under kebab for low-noise pages
Accessibility: ensure voiceover reads metric name then delta, and that action buttons have aria-labels
decisions: Embed cost snapshot rather than full cost chart to keep card compact
Show absolute token delta + dollar estimate for quick triage; detailed token-level breakdown links to cost dashboard
Postmortem shortcut will pre-populate a PR/incident summary template when possible (ux dev dependency)
On-call contact prioritized above paging to reduce noise for low-severity incidents
open_questions: Should we show estimated cost deltas for all teams by default or respect project-level opt-out?
How should we handle multiple SLOs attached to a single incident—aggregate or show top-2?
What permission is required to create a postmortem draft from the Quickcard? (design assumed editor role)
Do we need audit logging for 'Open Postmortem Draft' clicks for compliance customers?
